items.name: Little Artists Studio
items.description: Young artists explore paint, clay, collage, and print-making through playful, process-focused projects, and every session ends with a mini gallery walk to celebrate each child's work.

items.name: Primary Singers
items.description: A joyful beginning choir where students learn songs, rhythm games, and simple harmonies while building confidence singing together. The group performs at the winter and spring family showcases.

items.name: Creative Movement
items.description: Through stories, music, and imaginative games, young dancers build balance, coordination, and body awareness. No experience is needed, only energy and curiosity.

items.name: Handbell Choir
items.description: Students learn to read music and ring in sequence to create beautiful melodies as a team. Every ringer is responsible for specific notes, so teamwork is essential.

items.name: Steel Pan Ensemble
items.description: Learn to play the steel drum and perform island, pop, and jazz favorites. Students practice rhythm, ear training, and ensemble listening, and perform at school events and community festivals.

items.name: Drumline
items.description: The percussion backbone of Friday night athletics events. Members learn marching snare, bass, and cymbals techniques and perform original cadences at games and pep rallies.

items.name: Improv Troupe
items.description: Quick thinking, bold choices, and a lot of laughs. Troupe members train in long- and short-form improv games and perform at school events, with an end-of-year showcase.

items.name: Yearbook Staff
items.description: The team that documents the year in photos, design, and stories. Staffers learn layout design, interviewing, photography, deadlines, and editorial decision-making.

items.name: Mural Project
items.description: Students design and paint collaborative murals that brighten campus walls and community spaces. Participants learn sketching, scaling, color theory, and large-scale painting techniques.

items.name: Animation Studio
items.description: Bring drawings to life using stop-motion and digital tools. Teams storyboard, shoot, and edit short animated films that premiere at the spring film night.

items.name: Little Eagles Multi-Sport
items.description: A fun introduction to sports for our youngest athletes. Each week features a new activity such as tag games, soccer skills, relay races, and parachute play, all focused on movement and good sportsmanship.

items.name: Youth Soccer Clinic
items.description: Players learn dribbling, passing, shooting, and teamwork in small-sided games. The season ends with a friendly scrimmage for families.

items.name: Gymnastics & Tumbling
items.description: Students build strength, flexibility, and body control on mats, beams, and bars. Certified instructors teach progressive skills in a safe, supportive environment.

items.name: Flag Football
items.description: A fast-paced, non-contact league that teaches offensive plays, defensive coverage, and sportsmanship. The team competes against other area schools in a regional league.

items.name: Lacrosse
items.description: Develop cradling, passing, and shooting skills in one of the fastest-growing sports in the Southeast. Open to beginners as well as experienced players, with a competitive spring schedule.

items.name: Baseball
items.description: Varsity and junior varsity baseball for players who want to compete at a high level. Practices focus on fundamentals, conditioning, and game strategy, with a full spring regional schedule.
items.schedule: Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, 4:00–6:00 PM

items.name: Softball
items.description: A competitive program for varsity and junior varsity players, with an emphasis on pitching, hitting, defensive skills, and strong team culture throughout the spring season.
items.schedule: Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, 4:00–6:00 PM

items.name: Archery Club
items.description: Students learn range safety, form, and target shooting with certified instructors, with all equipment provided. A relaxing, focused sport that builds concentration and patience.

items.name: Fencing Club
items.description: Learn the basics of foil fencing, including footwork, blade control, and sportsmanship. Beginners are welcome, and the club attends regional youth tournaments.

items.name: Yoga & Mindful Movement
items.description: A calming mix of beginner yoga, stretching, breathing exercises, and guided relaxation. Students leave each session feeling refreshed and better equipped to handle stress.

items.name: Storytime Explorers
items.description: Our youngest readers gather for read-alouds, puppet shows, and story-inspired crafts. A cozy way to build a lifelong love of books.

items.name: Nature Explorers
items.description: Students hunt for bugs, track animals, identify plants, and keep a nature journal as they investigate the campus woods and creek. Come ready to get a little muddy!

items.name: Puzzle & Brain Games
items.description: Students tackle logic puzzles, Rubik's cubes, tangrams, and strategy games, building problem solving skills and perseverance while having fun with friends.

items.name: Anime & Manga Club
items.description: Fans of Japanese comics and animation meet to watch episodes, discuss stories, draw characters, and organize an annual cosplay day.

items.name: Podcasting Club
items.description: Write, record, and edit original podcasts on topics students care about. Members learn interviewing, scripting, audio editing, and how to publish for a school audience.

items.name: Magic & Illusion Club
items.description: Students learn card tricks, sleight of hand, and stage illusions, practice presentation skills, and perform their best tricks at the annual talent showcase.

items.name: Knitting & Crochet Circle
items.description: A relaxed, welcoming circle where beginners and experienced makers learn stitches, make scarves and hats, and donate finished projects to local shelters.

items.name: Spanish Conversation Club
items.description: Practice speaking Spanish in a low-pressure setting with games, music, film clips, and cultural food days. All levels welcome, from beginner to heritage speakers.

items.name: Dungeons & Dragons Guild
items.description: Players and game masters create characters, plan quests, and build stories together. A great place to practice teamwork, creativity, and imagination, with sessions for beginners and veterans.

items.name: Cycling Club
items.description: Group rides on local greenways build endurance and bike safety skills. Includes bike maintenance workshops, and helmets are required on every ride.

items.name: Kindness Ambassadors
items.description: Student ambassadors spread kindness around campus through compliment cards, buddy benches, and classroom service projects, learning that small acts can make a big difference.

items.name: Eagle Buddies
items.description: Fifth graders partner with younger students as reading buddies, recess helpers, and role models. A great first step into student leadership.

items.name: Class Officers Council
items.description: Elected class officers plan spirit weeks, homecoming events, and fundraisers while learning meeting skills, budgeting, and how to represent classmates' voices.

items.name: Public Speaking Lab
items.description: Build confidence speaking in front of groups. Members practice storytelling, persuasive speeches, and impromptu speaking, with supportive coaching from peers and faculty.

items.name: Student Wellness Council
items.description: Students lead campus-wide wellness initiatives such as mental health awareness weeks, stress-relief events, and peer support campaigns, in partnership with the counseling department.

items.name: Young Entrepreneurs
items.description: Students develop business ideas, pitch to a panel, and launch a pop-up shop at the spring market. Learn about marketing, budgeting, and customer service.

items.name: Diversity & Inclusion Alliance
items.description: A student-led community that celebrates cultures, identities, and perspectives through heritage month programs, guest speakers, and respectful dialogue.

items.name: Eagle Helpers
items.description: Our youngest students practice caring for others by making cards for patients and neighbors, collecting donations, and tending the campus garden. Service learning at a kindergarten level.

items.name: Book Drive Crew
items.description: Students collect, sort, and deliver thousands of gently used books to classrooms and libraries in need, and learn how literacy supports communities.

items.name: Habitat Build Crew
items.description: Students partner with local Habitat for Humanity chapters on weekend build days. No experience is needed, and training and safety gear are provided on site.

items.name: Tech Help for Seniors
items.description: Students visit local senior centers to teach older adults how to use smartphones, video calls, and online safety, and build patience and communication skills along the way.

items.name: Coat & Blanket Drive
items.description: Students organize seasonal drives for warm coats and blankets, then sort and deliver them to local shelters. They also learn about food and housing insecurity in our region.

items.name: Pen Pals Program
items.description: Students write letters and cards to veterans, nursing home residents, and partner classrooms, building empathy and writing skills one message at a time.

items.name: Little Scientists Lab
items.description: Hands-on experiments with bubbling volcanoes, slime, magnets, and simple machines spark curiosity about how the world works. Each session ends with a take-home science discovery.

items.name: Maker Space Explorers
items.description: Students invent, design, and build using cardboard, circuits, 3D printers, and recycled materials. Every session is a new challenge that celebrates creative problem solving.

items.name: World Languages Explorers
items.description: A fun first taste of Spanish, French, and Mandarin through songs, games, and cultural activities. Students discover how languages connect people around the world.

items.name: Stock Market Challenge
items.description: Teams manage virtual portfolios, research companies, and learn about investing, risk, and financial planning. Top teams compete in a statewide investing simulation each spring.

items.name: Math Circle
items.description: A collaborative space to explore puzzles, number theory, and creative problem solving beyond the classroom. Students share multiple strategies and celebrate the beauty of math.

items.name: Spelling & Vocabulary Bee
items.description: Students sharpen spelling, word roots, and vocabulary through games and friendly competitions that lead to the annual school bee and a path to regional contests.

items.name: Astronomy Club
items.description: Explore the night sky through telescopes, star maps, and space news. Members plan evening stargazing events, study planets and constellations, and track meteor showers.
